components.name: Primary button
components.description: The single dominant action within a region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; padding: 11px 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--brand, #245b78); color: #fffef7; font: 700 16px/1.4 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--brand-hover, #19465f); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #245fc4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: A supporting action that stays available without competing.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 15px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #a98a68); border-radius: 14px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #252724); font: 600 14px/1.4 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-muted, #fff1d2); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #245fc4); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: A persistent-label field for project context.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; color: var(--ink, #252724); font: 600 12px/1.5 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #a98a68); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface, #fffef7); color: var(--ink, #252724); font: 400 16px/1.5 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--focus, #245fc4); outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(36 95 196 / .15); }

components.name: Review card
components.description: A top-level surface for the latest Design Review.
components.html:
Latest Design Review

Mobile Fitness App Redesign

See what is working, understand the evidence, and choose a useful next step.
components.css: .ds-review-card { max-width: 420px; padding: 28px; border: 1px solid rgb(169 138 104 / .18); border-radius: 20px; background: var(--surface, #fffef7); color: var(--ink, #252724); box-shadow: 0 10px 32px rgb(79 61 35 / .08); font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-review-card > span { color: var(--brand, #245b78); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-review-card h3 { margin: 12px 0 8px; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-review-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft, #57594f); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Status badge
components.description: A text-and-marker treatment for confidence, priority, or review state.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { min-height: 28px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e0efe7; color: #2b6a50; font: 700 12px/1.4 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-status-badge i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #397a5f; }

components.name: Primary navigation
components.description: A calm sentence-case navigation that remains available on mobile.
components.html: HomeDesign reviewsHow reviews work
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 34px; overflow-x: auto; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 8px 0; color: var(--ink-soft, #57594f); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a.active { color: var(--ink, #252724); } .ds-nav a.active::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--brand, #245b78); content: ''; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #245fc4); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Design Mentor feels like working beside a trusted designer in a bright, welcoming studio. Warm cream surfaces create ease and generosity; clear blue accents provide direction; peach and apricot add selective human warmth around observations and encouragement. The user's interface remains the most visually important artifact. The system is modern and minimal without becoming sterile. Components are warm and quietly confident: rounded, spacious, legible, and calm.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral light with dependable blue guidance.
Soft ambient lift on meaningful surfaces.
Encouraging review language with visible evidence and uncertainty.

rules.name: The Warmth Leads Rule
rules.body: Cream is the environment, blue is the guide, and peach is an accent; no screen should become a field of competing pastel cards.

rules.name: The Dark Text on Pastels Rule
rules.body: Peach, apricot, cream, and sky surfaces always use dark text.

rules.name: The Meaning Twice Rule
rules.body: Status, priority, confidence, and score changes pair color with text, iconography, or position.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Helvetica Neue throughout; do not introduce Georgia, another serif, Inter, or a display typeface.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Navigation, labels, buttons, headings, metadata, and statuses use sentence case. Avoid all-caps styling and artificial tracking.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows create quiet separation, never floating-card spectacle. Do not stack shadows or nest elevated cards.

dos: Do make the screenshot and Design Review the clearest focal point.
Do use warm, educational language that explains evidence and preserves user agency.
Do create hierarchy with size, weight, spacing, and selective color.
Do keep body copy at 16px and essential targets at least 44px.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, reduced-motion support, and non-color status cues.
donts: Don't use Georgia, serif typography, mixed font families, all-caps labels, or editorial report styling.
Don't describe the product as an AI critic, chatbot, analytics dashboard, or final authority.
Don't overuse scores, metrics, bordered grids, pastel card collections, or nested elevated surfaces.
Don't use heavy gradients, glassmorphism, dark AI aesthetics, decorative glows, or corporate data-table density.
Don't claim screenshot review certifies usability or accessibility.
